positive: A finished frontend artifact needs an evidence-backed ship decision.
A pipeline report must aggregate specialist self-checks, browser evidence, and provenance.
negative: The artifact is still at the direction or implementation stage.
The request asks for taste feedback without a defined spec and measurable evidence.

exclusions: Never infer execution from a file existing or a claimed checkmark.
Never turn missing required measurement into n/a without a valid subject-absence reason.
Never let report presentation alter canonical evidence rows, measurements, skips, or verdict.

outputs.primary: fail-closed evidence ledger with a deterministic verdict and actionable gate report
artifacts: deterministic execution report with distinct failed checks

stop_conditions: Fail when the required spec is absent or the artifact was not built to it.
Fail when any required evidence row is missing, forged, or contradictory.
Fail when browser, cold-load, keyboard, zoom, theme, or reduced-motion evidence is required but absent.
notes: Canonical rows and verdict are deterministic. Three same-brief runs may vary their response architecture, visual-decision framing, and prose voice only when the linked report preserves every canonical fact, distinct failure, measurement, skip reason, provenance, and authoritative verdict. A single undifferentiated ledger is incomplete.
